accounts_credential_recovery_restricted.name: accounts_credential_recovery_restricted
accounts_credential_recovery_restricted.value: "kairn"."accounts"."credential_recovery" IS NULL OR "kairn"."accounts"."restricted_at" IS NOT NULL

journey_invitations_acceptance.name: journey_invitations_acceptance
journey_invitations_acceptance.value:
(
        ("kairn"."journey_invitations"."decision" = 'accepted' AND "kairn"."journey_invitations"."accepted_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "kairn"."journey_invitations"."accepted_generation" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("kairn"."journey_invitations"."decision" <> 'accepted' AND "kairn"."journey_invitations"."accepted_by" IS NULL
          AND "kairn"."journey_invitations"."accepted_generation" IS NULL)
      )

journeys_schedule_range.name: journeys_schedule_range
journeys_schedule_range.value: "kairn"."journeys"."intended_end_at" IS NULL OR ("kairn"."journeys"."intended_start_at" IS NOT NULL AND "kairn"."journeys"."intended_end_at" >= "kairn"."journeys"."intended_start_at")

restriction_events_editorial_scope.name: restriction_events_editorial_scope
restriction_events_editorial_scope.value: ("kairn"."restriction_events"."operation"::text = 'capability_removal') = ("kairn"."restriction_events"."affected_capability" IS NOT NULL) AND ("kairn"."restriction_events"."affected_capability" IS NULL OR "kairn"."restriction_events"."affected_capability" IN ('coauthor', 'publisher'))

original_export_grants_request_scope.name: original_export_grants_request_scope
original_export_grants_request_scope.value: ("kairn"."original_export_grants"."request_key" IS NULL) = ("kairn"."original_export_grants"."recipient_membership_generation" IS NULL) AND ("kairn"."original_export_grants"."request_key" IS NOT NULL OR "kairn"."original_export_grants"."decision" = 'approved')

source_grants_publication_consent.name: source_grants_publication_consent
source_grants_publication_consent.value: "kairn"."source_grants"."publication_consent" IS NULL OR ("kairn"."source_grants"."scope" = 'publication_reuse' AND "kairn"."source_grants"."withdrawn_at" IS NULL AND "kairn"."source_grants"."publication_consent" = 'members_unlisted_public_v1')
